headlines.title: INVL fund invests in the fish processing sector: signs agreements to acquire Nordian Group and Norvelita
headlines.summary: INVL Private Equity Fund II, one of the leading private equity funds in Central and Eastern Europe, has signed agreements to acquire two Lithuanian fish processing companies – Nordian Group and Norvelita. The combination of these two companies will create one of the largest fish processing groups in the region, with combined annual revenues of approximately EUR 200 million. By investing in these companies, the fund aims to grow them into regional leaders, competing with other major European processors.
